value.name: Marylin speaks anxiously with Ruth
value.description: Marylin tells Ruth that circumstances have changed and struggles to explain herself over the phone.
evidence: Marylin is on the phone with Ruth.

MARYLIN
But Ruth -- things have changed --
yes -- yes I understand. But you see --
I couldn't file, did I? And maybe I
wasn't going to file. Maybe -- maybe
Ruth -- Yes. Okay.

value.name: Marylin knocks on Miles's bedroom door
value.description: Marylin goes to Miles's bedroom and repeatedly asks him to open the door so she can talk to him.
evidence: The bedroom door is closed. Marylin knocks repeatedly.

MARYLIN
Miles? Open the door, Miles. Please
open the door. I want to talk to
you. Miles? I'm coming in. Here I
come.

value.name: Marylin enters Miles's empty bedroom
value.description: After announcing herself, Marylin pushes the bedroom door open and finds that Miles is not inside.
evidence: She pushes the door open. No Miles in sight.

value.name: Marylin discovers revenge note
value.description: Marylin finds a note on the bed quoting a passage about revenge, suggesting Miles's anger or emotional distress.
evidence:
On the bed,
scrawled on a piece of mMm stationery, taped to one of the
mMm Frette pillows -- a note which reads -- "If you prick
us, do we not bleed? If you tickle us, do we not laugh? If
you poison us, do we not die? AND IF YOU WRONG US SHALL WE
NOT REVENGE?"
